question: access

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, one IP
request.body: the same MCP initialize request as p-20260928-allium-mcp-unauthenticated eleven hours and a half earlier (jsonrpc 2.0, protocolVersion 2025-06-18, clientInfo public-agents-researcher 1.0), then a tools/list with no session header, then the same two tools/call requests by hand, get_realtime_supported_chains and realtime_get_supported_chains, each with empty arguments; then the two well-known metadata paths, the sign-in host, and the free and priced endpoints of agents.allium.so; Content-Type application/json, Accept application/json and text/event-stream

headers.www-authenticate: [redacted: this repository's credential filter refuses the literal header, which carries no credential. In words: a challenge of the bearer scheme whose resource_metadata parameter names https://mcp.allium.so/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource. The header as received is in the artifact]

decoded.initialize: 401, content-length 0, with the challenge above. At 06:31Z the same day the same request answered 200 with an SSE body naming serverInfo 1.0.1 and no challenge header (p-20260928-allium-mcp-unauthenticated, same artifact directory)
decoded.tools-list: 401 with the same challenge, where 06:31Z answered 200 with 48 tools
decoded.tools-call: both names, get_realtime_supported_chains and realtime_get_supported_chains, answer 401 with the same challenge, where 06:31Z answered 200 with a Not authenticated error result inside the JSON-RPC envelope. The refusal moved from the application layer to the transport
decoded.protected-resource-metadata: 200 at https://mcp.allium.so/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource: resource https://mcp.allium.so/, authorization_servers [https://mcp.allium.so/], scopes_supported [openid], bearer_methods_supported [header]. The same path answered 404 at 06:31Z and on 2026-09-20
decoded.authorization-server-metadata: 200 at https://mcp.allium.so/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server, read on this host for the first time: issuer https://mcp.allium.so/, authorize, token and register endpoints on the same host, scopes_supported [openid], response_types_supported [code], grant_types_supported [authorization_code, refresh_token], code_challenge_methods_supported [S256], client_id_metadata_document_supported true. A dynamic client registration endpoint is advertised; it was not called
decoded.sign-in-host: mcp-oauth.allium.so answers the same initialize 401 with a challenge naming its own protected-resource document, and that document answers 200 with the same four fields about itself. Unchanged from 06:31Z; the two hosts now answer a stranger the same way
decoded.paid-host: unchanged at 18:06Z: GET /api/v1/developer/tokens/search?q=usdc and POST /api/v1/developer/prices still answer 402 with an MPP challenge and an x402 version 2 document together, exact scheme, the same four networks, 30000 and 20000 units, Stripe custody fields on the Base and Solana entries only; the free supported-chains endpoint still answers 200 with no payment
decoded.cause: not established. A 401 carrying a well-formed RFC 9728 challenge, and a protected-resource document that changed from 404 to 200 in the same window, read as a deliberate configuration change rather than a block of this caller, but nothing was read from the vendor saying so and one IP cannot tell the two apart

finding: Measured twice on 2026-09-28 from the same container with no credentials: at 06:31Z mcp.allium.so answered initialize and tools/list 200 and listed 48 tools to a stranger, refusing only at the tool call, with its protected-resource path 404; at 18:04Z the same requests answered 401 with a challenge of the bearer scheme naming that path, and the path answered 200 with an authorization-server document (registration endpoint advertised, scopes openid) that had not been readable there before. The transport that had been open to a stranger since at least 2026-09-11 was closed within the same day, and the tool list is no longer readable without an account. The paid host measured at 18:06Z had not moved. What caused the change is not established: nothing read from the vendor announces it, and one IP cannot distinguish a configuration change from a block of this caller.
